verses.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.pt: No princípio criou Deus os céus e a terra.
verses.en_web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.en_bbe: At the first God made the heaven and the earth.

verses.en: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.pt: A terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo, mas o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre a face das águas.
verses.en_web: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.en_bbe: And the earth was waste and without form; and it was dark on the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God was moving on the face of the waters.

verses.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.pt: Disse Deus: haja luz. E houve luz.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

verses.en: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.pt: Viu Deus que a luz era boa; e fez separação entre a luz e as trevas.
verses.en_web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.en_bbe: And God, looking on the light, saw that it was good: and God made a division between the light and the dark,

verses.en: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.pt: E Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas noite. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia primeiro.
verses.en_web: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.en_bbe: Naming the light, Day, and the dark, Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.

verses.en: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: haja um firmamento no meio das águas, e haja separação entre águas e águas.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let there be a solid arch stretching over the waters, parting the waters from the waters.

verses.en: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.pt: Fez, pois, Deus o firmamento, e separou as águas que estavam debaixo do firmamento das que estavam por cima do firmamento. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And God made the arch for a division between the waters which were under the arch and those which were over it: and it was so.

verses.en: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.pt: Chamou Deus ao firmamento céu. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia segundo.
verses.en_web: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave the arch the name of Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.

verses.en: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Ajuntem-se num só lugar as águas que estão debaixo do céu, e apareça o elemento seco. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven come together in one place, and let the dry land be seen: and it was so.

verses.en: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.pt: Chamou Deus ao elemento seco terra, e ao ajuntamento das águas mares. E viu Deus que isso era bom.
verses.en_web: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave the dry land the name of Earth; and the waters together in their place were named Seas: and God saw that it was good.

verses.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra relva, ervas que dêem semente, e árvores frutíferas que, segundo as suas espécies, dêem fruto que tenha em si a sua semente, sobre a terra. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth”; and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let grass come up on the earth, and plants producing seed, and fruit-trees giving fruit, in which is their seed, after their sort: and it was so.

verses.en: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.pt: A terra, pois, produziu relva, ervas que davam semente segundo as suas espécies, e árvores que davam fruto que tinha em si a sua semente, segundo as suas espécies. E viu Deus que isso era bom.
verses.en_web: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.en_bbe: And grass came up on the earth, and every plant producing seed of its sort, and every tree producing fruit, in which is its seed, of its sort: and God saw that it was good.

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia terceiro.
verses.en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.en_bbe: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.

verses.en: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.pt: E disse Deus: haja luminares no firmamento do céu, para fazerem separação entre o dia e a noite; sejam eles para sinais e para estações, e para dias e anos;
verses.en_web: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let there be lights in the arch of heaven, for a division between the day and the night, and let them be for signs, and for marking the changes of the year, and for days and for years:

verses.en: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.pt: e sirvam de luminares no firmamento do céu, para alumiar a terra. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And let them be for lights in the arch of heaven to give light on the earth: and it was so.

verses.en: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
verses.pt: Deus, pois, fez os dois grandes luminares: o luminar maior para governar o dia, e o luminar menor para governar a noite; fez também as estrelas.
verses.en_web: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.en_bbe: And God made the two great lights: the greater light to be the ruler of the day, and the smaller light to be the ruler of the night: and he made the stars.

verses.en: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.pt: E Deus os pôs no firmamento do céu para alumiar a terra,
verses.en_web: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
verses.en_bbe: And God put them in the arch of heaven, to give light on the earth;

verses.en: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.pt: para governar o dia e a noite, e para fazer separação entre a luz e as trevas. E viu Deus que isso era bom.
verses.en_web: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
verses.en_bbe: To have rule over the day and the night, and for a division between the light and the dark: and God saw that it was good.

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quarto.
verses.en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.en_bbe: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.

verses.en: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Produzam as águas cardumes de seres viventes; e voem as aves acima da terra no firmamento do céu.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let the waters be full of living things, and let birds be in flight over the earth under the arch of heaven.

verses.en: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.pt: Criou, pois, Deus os monstros marinhos, e todos os seres viventes que se arrastavam, os quais as águas produziram abundantemente segundo as suas espécies; e toda ave que voa, segundo a sua espécie. E viu Deus que isso era bom.
verses.en_web: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.en_bbe: And God made great sea-beasts, and every sort of living and moving thing with which the waters were full, and every sort of winged bird: and God saw that it was good.

verses.en: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.pt: Então Deus os abençoou, dizendo: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos, e enchei as águas dos mares; e multipliquem-se as aves sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And God gave them his blessing, saying, Be fertile and have increase, making all the waters of the seas full, and let the birds be increased in the earth.

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quinto.
verses.en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.en_bbe: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.

verses.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra seres viventes segundo as suas espécies: animais domésticos, répteis, e animais selvagens segundo as suas espécies. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let the earth give birth to all sorts of living things, cattle and all things moving on the earth, and beasts of the earth after their sort: and it was so.

verses.en: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.pt: Deus, pois, fez os animais selvagens segundo as suas espécies, e os animais domésticos segundo as suas espécies, e todos os répteis da terra segundo as suas espécies. E viu Deus que isso era bom.
verses.en_web: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.en_bbe: And God made the beast of the earth after its sort, and the cattle after their sort, and everything moving on the face of the earth after its sort: and God saw that it was good.

verses.en: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem, conforme a nossa semelhança; domine ele sobre os peixes do mar, sobre as aves do céu, sobre os animais domésticos, e sobre toda a terra, e sobre todo réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Let us make man in our image, like us: and let him have rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over the cattle and over all the earth and over every living thing which goes flat on the earth.

verses.en: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.pt: Criou, pois, Deus o homem à sua imagem; à imagem de Deus o criou; homem e mulher os criou.
verses.en_web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.en_bbe: And God made man in his image, in the image of God he made him: male and female he made them.

verses.en: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.pt: Então Deus os abençoou e lhes disse: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos; enchei a terra e sujeitai-a; dominai sobre os peixes do mar, sobre as aves do céu e sobre todos os animais que se arrastam sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And God gave them his blessing and said to them, Be fertile and have increase, and make the earth full and be masters of it; be rulers over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing moving on the earth.

verses.en: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes mais: Eis que vos tenho dado todas as ervas que produzem semente, as quais se acham sobre a face de toda a terra, bem como todas as árvores em que há fruto que dê semente; ser-vos-ão para mantimento.
verses.en_web: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, See, I have given you every plant producing seed, on the face of all the earth, and every tree which has fruit producing seed: they will be for your food:

verses.en: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
verses.pt: E a todos os animais da terra, a todas as aves do céu e a todo ser vivente que se arrasta sobre a terra, tenho dado todas as ervas verdes como mantimento. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
verses.en_bbe: And to every beast of the earth and to every bird of the air and every living thing moving on the face of the earth I have given every green plant for food: and it was so.

verses.en: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.pt: E viu Deus tudo quanto fizera, e eis que era muito bom. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia sexto.
verses.en_web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
verses.en_bbe: And God saw everything which he had made and it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
